foreignFailureIdentityCatch.apps/server/src/haus-server-shutdown.ts: Shutdown deliberately rethrows the first foreign resource failure unchanged after all finalizers complete.

unknownErrorChannel.apps/server/src/haus-server-shutdown.ts: Shutdown deliberately preserves the foreign resource failure identity at the finalizer boundary.

apps/computer/src/browser/linux-chrome-d.reason: Detection awaits each bounded --version probe and closes the ELF header file descriptor in lexical finally; it owns no detached work.

apps/computer/src/daemon-memory-guard.ts.reason: A dev-only process watchdog: one unref'd interval reads the daemon's own resident set and, past the limit, clears itself and exits the process. It owns no other resource, never keeps the process alive, and ends with the process.

apps/computer/src/pid-lock.ts.reason: One awaited operation acquires an exclusive pid lock file with a bounded acquisition deadline and removes it in lexical finally; acquisition closes its file handle in lexical finally. The awaited retry delay owns no detached timer or background task.

apps/server/src/server-agents/execution-.reason: Each run holds at most one trailing notice timer and one forget timer, each firing once within a second of its schedule; the process-lifetime emitter owns no other resource.

apps/server/src/voice/voice-call.ts.reason: The Server runtime owns each call's scoped fixed-rate synchronization fiber and joins in-flight database delivery on socket shutdown. Four bounded timers adapt foreign WebSocket startup, idle-call duration, and graceful closure deadlines.

apps/server/src/artifacts/retention.ts.reason: One awaited sweep run drains bounded claim batches and announces each affected Server once in lexical finally. It owns no timer or background task; the boot sweep's closing signal stops it between revisions.

apps/server/src/artifacts/thumbnails.ts.reason: Bounded thumbnail render queue: the manual promise parks a render until a slot frees and the finally hands that slot on. Server acquires the queue in its Effect Scope; close stops admission and joins renders in flight before database teardown.

apps/server/src/boot-sweep.ts.reason: Upstream fixed-interval maintenance adapter retains its deterministic timer seam. Server acquires each sweep in its Effect Scope; close stops admission, aborts the closing signal a long run checks between steps, and joins the in-flight database write before database teardown.

apps/computer/src/agent-skill-files.ts.reason: One atomic skill-file replacement removes its temporary file before the command returns.

apps/computer/src/attachment-keychain.ts.reason: A Keychain read races one bounded timer that the lexical finally clears, and the shared in-flight read forgets itself when it settles.

apps/computer/src/attachment-state.ts.reason: A finite pending-setup transaction removes its lock before returning.

apps/computer/src/attachment-store.ts.reason: A finite atomic filesystem write removes its temporary file before returning.

apps/computer/src/daemon-runtime.ts.reason: This is the Computer composition root that creates and disposes the single daemon Effect runtime.

apps/computer/src/index.ts.reason: The Computer composition root bridges WebSocket closure and the terminal restart timer to owned services.

apps/computer/src/invocations/attachment.reason: An agent-fence that arrives before the invocation handler is ready waits in the arrival queue on one resolver, which the queue settles when it delivers the fence or when the handler fails to start; no timer or listener is attached.

apps/computer/src/invocations/offline-ho.reason: While the Server socket is down, a queued invocation waits on one shared resolver that reconnect resolves, or on its own call's abort signal; the once listener lives on that call's AbortController, which is dropped when the call settles, and parking resolvers only signal tests that a call is waiting.

apps/computer/src/invocations/bash.ts.reason: Adapts one bash process group to an invocation: the abort listener and the five-second SIGKILL timer are cleared in lexical finally once the shell and its pipes settle.

apps/computer/src/invocations/codex/appl.reason: The apply_patch test runner passes a fresh, never-aborted signal when a test does not supply its own; nothing listens to it.
One module-level signal that never aborts carries the patch's write phase, so a cancel that arrives after the pre-write check cannot leave a patch half applied; no listener or timer is attached.

apps/computer/src/invocations/browser.ts.reason: Each browser invocation streams agent-browser output into one output tail whose log file is finished and closed in lexical finally once the process settles.

apps/computer/src/invocations/editor-vie.reason: A view closes the one non-blocking file handle it opened in lexical finally after a bounded read; it owns no detached work.

apps/computer/src/invocations/handler-ru.reason: The invocation timeout timer aborts the run's controller and is cleared in lexical finally when the operation returns or throws.

apps/computer/src/invocations/handler.ts.reason: One AbortController per active invocation carries cancel; the active entry is removed in finally after the finished record is durable, the session slot is released in finally, and every frame's work is tracked until settled().

apps/computer/src/invocations/ledger.ts.reason: Each ledger write closes its temp file handle in a lexical finally before the atomic rename; the ledger owns no background work.

apps/computer/src/invocations/payload-se.reason: The test payload server can hold requests open: one resolver signals arrival and another releases every held request when the test stops the server.

apps/computer/src/invocations/pi/shell.t.reason: Ported Pi child-process wait: one manual promise settles on exit or close, with a fixed post-exit grace timer cleared on settlement so descendants holding the pipes never hang it.

apps/computer/src/desktop/desktop-lock.t.reason: Adapts one lockf process group, which owns both the kernel lock and the command, to an abort signal: the held line on the control pipe resolves the wait, an abort kills the whole group, and closing stdin ends the group.

apps/computer/src/desktop/desktop-proces.reason: Adapts one agent-desktop process group to an abort signal: cancel and timeout kill the whole group, and the listener is removed once the group and its pipes settle.

apps/computer/src/desktop/fixtures/hold-.reason: A child process for desktop-lock.test.ts that holds the real lock until the test writes to its stdin.

apps/computer/src/invocations/stream-pro.reason: Adapts one spawned child to an abort signal: the abort listener that terminates the child is removed in lexical finally once the child and its pipes settle.

apps/computer/src/drive-migration/drive-.reason: The awaited seed render removes its scratch directory under runtime/ in lexical finally before returning the entries it read.

apps/computer/src/login.ts.reason: The awaited login command removes its TTY listener and temporary credential file before returning.

apps/computer/src/reminder-script-execut.reason: The daemon runtime owns reminder subprocess execution and translates Effect interruption into the child AbortSignal.

apps/computer/src/reminder-script.ts.reason: The daemon runtime owns in-flight reminder execution while the finalizer evicts only the completed single-flight entry.

apps/computer/src/test-port.ts.reason: This production-adjacent test helper only adapts Node server callbacks to reserve an ephemeral test port.

apps/computer/src/update-install.ts.reason: Each signed executable installation is a finite atomic file transaction that removes staged artifacts on failure.

apps/computer/src/update-locks.ts.reason: The update command holds a filesystem admission lock only for one awaited operation and releases it in finally.

apps/computer/src/update.ts.reason: The signed update transaction is finite and awaited by its daemon owner; finalizers release its PID lock and artifacts.

apps/computer/src/usage/claude-plan-usag.reason: A finite per-file write queue serializes atomic usage-state updates and evicts its completed Promise entry.
The request-scoped single-flight cache clears its completed provider request before returning to callers.

apps/computer/src/usage/computer-usage-c.reason: The request-scoped usage refresh is a finite single-flight operation that clears its Promise after settlement.

apps/computer/src/workspace-files.ts.reason: A finite workspace preview closes its local file handle before returning the bounded result.

apps/server/src/agent-invocations/invoca.reason: The invocation grace timer seam: the router cancels each scheduled grace when its invocation settles or its Computer reconnects, and close cancels every grace still open.
A payload upload releases its Server write hold in lexical finally; the staged upload it wraps owns its own file cleanup.

apps/server/src/agent-api/attachments.ts.reason: Each attachment request closes its staged file and discards incomplete storage while preserving the primary route error.

apps/server/src/attachments/attachment-r.reason: A finite directory synchronization closes its filesystem handle before returning.
The attachment write admission token is held for one awaited operation and released in its finalizer.

apps/server/src/attachments/reconcile-at.reason: Startup reconciliation hashes one attachment through a local handle and closes it before validation returns.

apps/server/src/avatar-generation/servic.reason: One awaited avatar request releases its per-actor admission permit on every outcome.

apps/server/src/computers/socket-livenes.reason: One unref'd ping interval per attachment socket adapts ws transport liveness; the socket close handler stops it. An on-demand presence probe adapts one ping to a Promise with a bounded deadline that settles on pong, frame, timeout, or stop.

apps/server/src/computers/socket.ts.reason: ServerPostCommitWork owns reconnect work; the remaining Promise only adapts WebSocketServer close callbacks. Best-effort attach sends (Server runtime settings) ignore a failure because the next attach resends them.

apps/server/src/development/seed-chat-at.reason: Development bootstrap stages one attachment and always discards the bounded staging artifact after commit or failure.

apps/server/src/haus-api/socket-session..reason: Each App socket holds at most one session-expiry timer; refresh rearms it and dispose clears it, so it never outlives its socket.

apps/server/src/haus-server-application..reason: The Server composition root creates one runtime and orders every owned service finalizer before database disposal.

apps/server/src/haus-server-stop.ts.reason: The process signal handler races the application close against one deadline timer, clears it, and ends the process; the runtime it would use is disposed by that close.

apps/server/src/postgres/bootstrap.ts.reason: Fresh-schema bootstrap uses one finite administrative connection and closes it before migration continues.

apps/server/src/postgres/migrations.ts.reason: The finite migration command closes its dedicated PostgreSQL client after applying and reading migration state.

apps/server/src/push/apns-sender.ts.reason: node:http2 APNs adapter: wraps one request stream in a Promise with a stream timeout, and pings each session on an unref'd interval whose deadline destroys a dead session; the interval is cleared when the session closes. Every failure becomes a push outcome; nothing retries.

apps/server/src/push/message-push.ts.reason: Durable-event listener for iPhone push. Server acquires it in its Effect Scope; close aborts the subscription, logs any other listener failure, and drains the bounded push queue before database teardown.

apps/server/src/push/push-queue.ts.reason: Bounded-concurrency queue for iPhone push tasks owned by message-push; a task's read-grace delay is one setTimeout counted in the backlog, tasks settle their own errors, and drain resolves once every delayed, queued, and running task has settled.

apps/server/src/server-mcp/client-cache..reason: The injected Server runtime owns MCP acquisition, operations, retirement, bounded close, and interruption translation.

apps/server/src/server-mcp/icon-loader.t.reason: The Server runtime owns concurrent icon probes and translates fiber interruption to each foreign HTTP AbortSignal.

apps/server/src/server-mcp/runtime-test-.reason: Deterministic MCP lifecycle fixtures expose a one-tick timer only to runtime tests.

apps/server/src/image-generation/run-ima.reason: One awaited generation run settles its durable row and re-announces the final state in lexical finally. It owns no detached timer or background task; boot recovery fails rows left generating.

apps/server/src/identity/cloudflare-acce.reason: Cloudflare admission verification awaits a third-party key set. The deadline timer bounds one jose JWKS fetch, the abandoned fetch's rejection is observed so a late failure cannot become an unhandled rejection, and a missed deadline discards that key set so the next request builds a fresh one.

apps/server/src/identity/session-connect.reason: Each tracked App socket or SSE response owns one access-expiry timer; fresh admission rearms it and close or local session revocation clears it and detaches its listener. Timers cannot outlive their connections.

apps/server/src/agent-api/mcp-routes.ts.reason: Each authenticated HTTP handler releases its cancellation registry entry in finally; the existing MCP runtime owns upstream interruption.

apps/server/src/agent-api/dispatch-gate..reason: Each dispatch flight is one HTTP request: its Promise.withResolvers settles exactly once in land(), which also deletes the flight entry, and a running flight lands when that request's onSend hook finishes it, so concurrent duplicates wait on one response.

apps/server/src/server-mcp/requests.ts.reason: Bounded request cancellation registry adapting HTTP messages to AbortSignals. Entries release with handlers, expire on access, and abort at Fastify shutdown; no background work is launched.

apps/computer/src/runtime-issues.ts.reason: Finite atomic runtime observation writes serialize per file and release the queue entry after settlement; failures propagate to the caller.

apps/computer/src/attachment-daemon-work.reason: The attachment runtime bounds accepted Worker work with an Effect deadline; the finally block then releases routing.

apps/computer/src/attachment-shutdown.ts.reason: Node signal and PID adapters join one finite daemon drain. The terminal disposal deadline is outside the Effect runtime because that runtime is being disposed; timeout and polling timers are cleared or bounded.

apps/computer/src/harness/stopped-turn.t.reason: Bounds a runtime driver turn's settle with one deadline timer that the finally block always clears; the executor owns the turn and fails it when the deadline wins.

apps/server/src/server-agents/agent-thou.reason: Only threads an injectable schedule into the thought cadence; the cadence owns its timers.

apps/server/src/server-agents/thought-ca.reason: Each request holds at most one waiting-frame timer and one held still-line timer, each firing once or cancelled when a newer line shows; entries expire after ten idle minutes. Phrasing runs as post-commit background work.

apps/server/src/hosted-mcp/process.ts.reason: Foreign subprocess and Unix HTTP adapter; the Server Effect scope owns admission, retries and release. The bounded stop deadline reaps the connector and reported account worker groups.

apps/server/src/hosted-mcp/test-fixture..reason: Private socket and detached account worker fixture for Server supervision and process-tree cleanup tests.

apps/server/src/hosted-mcp/verify-packag.reason: Finite packaging verification closes its MCP client, owned Effect scope, runtime and temporary fixture storage before returning.

apps/server/src/server-mcp/service.ts.reason: A finite diagnostic refresh resumes background inventory reconciliation on both success and failure; MCP runtime scopes own recurring discovery and client retirement.

apps/server/src/server-mcp/inventory.ts.reason: The Server runtime owns scoped, fixed-delay MCP reconciliation through Effect clocks; connection revisions serialize inventory writes and suppress late results after client retirement. Finite Promise cleanup removes settled single-flight and write entries.

apps/computer/src/runtime/claude-code/cl.reason: One awaited pinned-binary install unpacks into a staging directory that finally always removes; concurrent callers share the same install promise.

apps/computer/src/drive/pull.ts.reason: A pull restores read-only folder modes in its finally block whether or not every change applied.

apps/computer/src/drive/push.ts.reason: A push restores read-only folder modes in its finally block whether or not the Server answered every request.

apps/computer/src/agent-reset-frames.ts.reason: A full reset holds the Agent's Drive pushes and its resetting mark only while it clears the folder, and lexical finally resumes both; the frame handler hands the one reset promise to the daemon's tracked writers.

apps/computer/src/drive/turn-sync.ts.reason: A Drive sync revokes the run credential it minted once it ends, and the per-folder queue drops its settled turn; a failed revoke leaves a credential that expires on its own.

apps/computer/src/serialized.ts.reason: A finite per-key lock serializes per-repo git work; each lock releases before its Promise returns and the key is dropped once no successor waits.

apps/computer/src/durable-json.ts.reason: A durable JSON write closes its file handle and removes only its own temporary file after the rename, whether or not the write finished.

apps/computer/src/repos/agent-use.ts.reason: An in-process per-Agent use lock: each invocation and each worktree cleanup runs one awaited callback and releases its count or its cleaning promise in lexical finally, so a cleanup never removes a worktree while an invocation of that Agent runs. It owns no timer or detached work.

apps/computer/src/invocations/processes/.reason: Each record write and log read closes its file handle in a lexical finally; the records own no background work.
Each background process owns one exit promise resolved once its record is written; the spawn log handle closes in finally, and a stop's SIGKILL timer is cleared in finally when the process exits.

apps/computer/src/invocations/session-fe.reason: Each archive write closes its temp file handle in a lexical finally before the atomic rename.

apps/computer/src/invocations/session-fr.reason: The test frame sink resolves one waiter per awaited frame type when the handler sends it.

apps/computer/src/invocations/session-sl.reason: A call waiting for an invocation slot holds one promise, resolved by the releasing call or by its own abort, which also removes the waiter.
